title: Spawn Filter Group Map
description: Filters allow data objects to specify test criteria which allows their use. Filters can be defined by a single object of type (Filter Test), an array of tests, collection groups, or a combination of these objects.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: The domain the test should be performed in.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The subject of this filter test.

test.title: Test
test.description: The name of the test to apply.

value.title: Value
value.description: The value being compared with the test.

AND.description:
Evaluates all tests in the group, all must pass in order for the group to pass.

Properties:
• domain (object)
• operator (object)
• subject (object)
• test (string)
• value (object)
